acceptance.summary: The production surface no longer exposes a fabricated llama.cpp client. The opt-in laboratory wrapper keeps handles private, carries the exclusive KV borrow lifetime, is deliberately !Send + !Sync, never dereferences either handle, and returns typed Unsupported until real tokenization, decode and generation are independently qualified.
coverage: private NonNull context and KV handles
exclusive mutable KV lifetime retained by the wrapper type
explicit !Send and !Sync marker with compile-fail coverage
laboratory-only llama-ffi-lab feature absent from default builds
typed fail-closed Unsupported for proposal and completion
default, public-feature and all-feature tests and Clippy
limitations: No real llama.cpp inference is claimed; the backend intentionally remains Unsupported until known-model end-to-end qualification.
No local Cargo execution is claimed because Cargo was unavailable; local git diff --check and workflow YAML parsing succeeded.
The initial candidate failed only Clippy drop_non_drop in the regression test; the final exact head uses a lexical scope and all candidate and target gates passed.

pull_requests.integration: automatic squash integration observed after green exact-head checks; the guarded manual merge was not repeated after detecting the already-integrated target

coverage: Clippy default/public/all features with zero warnings
workspace tests and doctests default/public/all features
Docker musl image build and rsi-demo smoke

review.result: Exact final diff inspected after the lexical-scope fix; no inline review threads and no unresolved discussion.

diagnostic_attempts.reason: drop_non_drop in the memory-preservation test was replaced by a lexical scope; strict-provenance Miri had already succeeded
